posts.title: The standing instructions I give every AI chat
posts.description: Claude and ChatGPT both let you write instructions that apply to every conversation on your account. ChatGPT calls them custom instructions, Claude just instructions, and you’ll find them in the app’s settings. Whatever you write there comes along into every chat you start. For years mine were whatever had come to mind at the time, mostly some version of “don’t flatter me” and “challenge my ideas”
